Class IntentPruner

java.lang.Object
org.iam.core.IntentPruner
public final class IntentPruner extends Object
Phase 1 of the intent reducer: splits a set of candidate intents into the necessary ones and the rest, so that the min-set-cover stage never has to run equivalence class (EC) partitioning for the necessary ones.

An intent is necessary when it owns a unique space, i.e. when I ∧ ¬(⋃ of all other candidate intents) ∧ P is non-empty: some request allowed by the policy is covered by I and by no other candidate, so every minimal cover of the policy has to contain I. The union of all other intents is not rebuilt per intent (which would cost O(|S|²) BDD operations); it is read off the prefix and suffix disjunctions of the candidate list (Definition 3), which cost one BDD operation per intent, making the whole pass O(|S|).

The candidates that survive, together with the policy space left uncovered by the necessary intents, are what the caller hands to the EC/ILP set cover.
